description: Long-lived Native Desktop performance red-line gates. This layer assembles Station mirror, sampler, runtime matrix, and traceability evidence into a fail-closed merge/readiness judgment.

logic.question: Can the Native runtime matrix make a source-bound pass/fail judgment for Desktop interaction budgets without hiding missing evidence?
logic.invariant: Missing sampler, Native runtime-cell, or Station mirror source proof keeps the result PARTIAL/UNPROVEN and sampleEmissionAllowed=false.
